correctness.rationale: For every number of blocks, direct matching constraints give an exact simplicial identity between the full nonmatching complex, a contractible simplex-join core and one join of two paths per unordered pair of blocks. Each join is a closed 3-ball, its exact core intersection is its full boundary, and any overlap of distinct joins lies in the core. The CW quotient is precisely a wedge of 3-spheres, proving integral homotopy. Orientation of the nine-tetrahedron relative fundamental chains yields the integral signed action. The standalone verifier independently checks exact face sets, intersection hypotheses, mod-two homology and integral oriented-chain transformations for widths 1–4; the infinite claim relies on the symbolic argument, not these finite tests.

value.rationale: This is a natural infinite sparse bipartite cactus family at the earliest nontrivial three-matching threshold. It provides a complete integral homotopy type and full integral automorphism module, exhibits a quadratic family of independent top-allowed classes without any simple cycle of length six, and supplies a transparent topological explanation by pair-indexed three-ball attachments beyond general Leray bounds and long-cycle sufficient conditions.
